name: migrate-canvas-styled-to-tailwind
conclusion_quantitative: migrate-canvas-styled-to-tailwind (Escalate) specifies 2 of 5 categories: 1 approval gate, 2 validation rules; none for autonomy limits, clarification rules, escalation rules. Strongest: validation rules.
conclusion_qualitative: migrate-canvas-styled-to-tailwind migrates a canvas component from Emotion styled-components to Tailwind classes following a reference migration. Most of the file is migration patterns and class mappings. Its control rules are an approval of the migration plan and a verification step. It sets no autonomy limits, clarification rules or rules for escalating failures.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never forbids or restricts any action of the agent on files, commands, tools or other systems, and never tells it to go ahead without asking.

clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to ask the user for missing or unclear information, or to avoid guessing.

approval_gates.conclusion_quantitative: 1 approval gate (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose.
approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in running text. The agent gets the user's approval of the migration plan before proceeding.

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 2 validation rules (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly heading.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 2 rules, both strict, 1 tied to a situation, evenly split between a heading and running text. The agent runs a verification step after the migration and checks Storybook for visual regressions when stories exist.

statements.quote: Check Storybook visually for regressions if stories exist for the component.

escalation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent what to do when something goes wrong, such as stopping or reporting an error to the user.
